- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 650" width="800" height="650" role="img" aria-label="Animated giant anteater riding a unicycle while juggling three colorful glass bottles">
  <defs>
    <!-- Sky & Spotlight Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff4dc"/>
      <stop offset="58%" stop-color="#fde3b9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f7cfa0"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <radialGradient id="spotlightGrad" cx="54%" cy="42%" r="48%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.72"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#fff7e2" stop-opacity="0.28"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f7cfa0" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <linearGradient id="groundGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#d8a26e"/>
      <stop offset="18%" stop-color="#c98e58"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#a66d3d"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Anteater Fur Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="bodyFurGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#846e60"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#6b564a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#513f36"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="snoutGrad" x1="0%" y1="50%" x2="100%" y2="20%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7c6659"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#5d4a40"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#352a25"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="tailMainGrad" x1="100%" y1="50%" x2="0%" y2="30%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#665045"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#533d33"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3c2b24"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="creamFurGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f5ecd9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#dfd0b6"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Metallic & Tire Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="chromeGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9aa5b1"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#eef2f6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7b8794"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="rimGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f6d365"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#e09f3e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b5761e"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Glass Bottle Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="greenBottleGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1b7a46"/>
      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#34b36b"/>
      <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#1e874e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#115430"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="blueBottleGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1d4e89"/>
      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#3d85c6"/>
      <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#245ea3"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#133863"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="amberBottleGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9e3b18"/>
      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#e06734"/>
      <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#bd4a20"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#78280d"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- ClipPath for Torso Markings -->
    <clipPath id="torsoClip">
      <path d="M 346 392 C 336 364, 344 316, 362 276 C 372 262, 392 266, 398 282 C 414 312, 418 354, 402 394 C 392 414, 356 414, 346 392 Z"/>
    </clipPath>

    <!-- ClipPath for Scrolling Ground Stage -->
    <clipPath id="stageClip">
      <rect x="0" y="555" width="800" height="95"/>
    </clipPath>

    <!-- Reusable Bottle Designs (Centered at 0,0) -->
    <g id="bottleGreen">
      <!-- Bottle Body & Neck -->
      <path d="M -5 -26 L 5 -26 L 5 -21 C 5 -14, 11 -9, 11 -1 L 11 21 C 11 25, 8 27, 0 27 C -8 27, -11 25, -11 21 L -11 -1 C -11 -9, -5 -14, -5 -21 Z"
            fill="url(#greenBottleGrad)" stroke="#0e4225" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <!-- Gold Cap & Lip -->
      <rect x="-6" y="-29" width="12" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#f4c430" stroke="#8c670f" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <!-- Vintage Cream & Crimson Label -->
      <rect x="-9.5" y="1" width="19" height="15" rx="2" fill="#fdf6e2" stroke="#c93b2b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="8.5" r="3.8" fill="#d94534"/>
      <!-- Specular Glass Highlight -->
      <path d="M -7 -3 C -7 -8, -3 -12, -3 -19 L -3 -24" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.68"/>
      <line x1="-7" y1="2" x2="-7" y2="21" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.52"/>
    </g>

    <g id="bottleBlue">
      <path d="M -5 -26 L 5 -26 L 5 -20 C 5 -13, 11.5 -8, 11.5 0 L 11.5 21 C 11.5 25, 8 27, 0 27 C -8 27, -11.5 25, -11.5 21 L -11.5 0 C -11.5 -8, -5 -13, -5 -20 Z"
            fill="url(#blueBottleGrad)" stroke="#0f2c4f" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <!-- Gold Foil Neck & Cork -->
      <path d="M -5 -26 L 5 -26 L 5.5 -18 L -5.5 -18 Z" fill="#f2c14e" stroke="#8f6814" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="-4" y="-30" width="8" height="4.5" rx="1.2" fill="#c68b59" stroke="#6e4726" stroke-width="1.1"/>
      <!-- Diamond Label -->
      <polygon points="0,-1 9,9 0,19 -9,9" fill="#fff8e7" stroke="#e09f3e" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <polygon points="0,3 5,9 0,15 -5,9" fill="#2b6cb0"/>
      <!-- Specular Glass Highlight -->
      <path d="M -7.5 0 C -7.5 -6, -3 -11, -3 -17" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.68"/>
      <line x1="-7.5" y1="4" x2="-7.5" y2="21" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.52"/>
    </g>

    <g id="bottleAmber">
      <path d="M -5 -26 L 5 -26 L 5 -20 C 5 -13, 11 -9, 11 -1 L 11 21 C 11 25, 8 27, 0 27 C -8 27, -11 25, -11 21 L -11 -1 C -11 -9, -5 -13, -5 -20 Z"
            fill="url(#amberBottleGrad)" stroke="#5c1d08" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <!-- Striped Carnival Label & Cap -->
      <rect x="-6" y="-29" width="12" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#e63946" stroke="#781720" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <rect x="-9.5" y="1" width="19" height="14" rx="2" fill="#fff8e8" stroke="#8a3214" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <line x1="-6" y1="5" x2="6" y2="5" stroke="#e06734" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="-6" y1="10" x2="6" y2="10" stroke="#2a9d8f" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <!-- Specular Glass Highlight -->
      <path d="M -7 -2 C -7 -8, -3 -12, -3 -19 L -3 -24" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.68"/>
      <line x1="-7" y1="3" x2="-7" y2="21" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.52"/>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <!-- ==================== 1. BACKGROUND & FESTIVE SCENE ==================== -->
  <rect width="800" height="650" fill="url(#skyGrad)"/>
  <rect width="800" height="650" fill="url(#spotlightGrad)"/>

  <!-- Drifting Soft Clouds -->
  <g opacity="0.62" fill="#fffaf0">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; -60,0; 0,0" dur="18s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M 110 135 C 110 118, 132 110, 148 120 C 160 102, 192 104, 202 122 C 218 118, 232 130, 230 144 L 112 144 Z"/>
      <path d="M 615 110 C 615 95, 636 88, 650 97 C 664 82, 692 84, 700 100 C 716 98, 728 109, 725 121 L 618 121 Z"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Distant Soft Carnival Hills & Tent Silhouettes -->
  <path d="M 0 560 Q 170 505 350 542 T 800 530 L 800 565 L 0 565 Z" fill="#efd0a8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Muted Distant Circus Tent Left -->
  <g opacity="0.45" transform="translate(88, 496)">
    <polygon points="-42,50 0,6 42,50" fill="#e06d53"/>
    <polygon points="-14,50 0,6 14,50" fill="#fff3dd"/>
    <rect x="-36" y="50" width="72" height="18" fill="#e06d53"/>
    <rect x="-12" y="50" width="24" height="18" fill="#fff3dd"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="6" x2="0" y2="-6" stroke="#b5523b" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="0,-6 12,-2 0,2" fill="#f4a261"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Muted Distant Park Trees Right -->
  <g opacity="0.38" fill="#c99b6b">
    <circle cx="695" cy="518" r="26"/>
    <circle cx="725" cy="525" r="20"/>
    <circle cx="668" cy="528" r="18"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Festive Bunting Flags Across Top Corners -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 400 0; 0.8 400 0; 0 400 0; -0.8 400 0; 0 400 0" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <!-- Left Garland -->
    <path d="M -10 18 Q 115 72 245 12" fill="none" stroke="#8d6e63" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <polygon points="18,29 38,36 23,56" fill="#e63946"/>
    <polygon points="56,41 78,45 64,67" fill="#f4a261"/>
    <polygon points="98,48 120,49 109,72" fill="#2a9d8f"/>
    <polygon points="140,48 162,44 155,69" fill="#e9c46a"/>
    <polygon points="182,40 203,32 200,58" fill="#457b9d"/>
    <!-- Right Garland -->
    <path d="M 575 10 Q 690 68 810 22" fill="none" stroke="#8d6e63" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <polygon points="602,22 622,30 606,50" fill="#2a9d8f"/>
    <polygon points="640,36 662,42 648,64" fill="#e63946"/>
    <polygon points="682,45 704,47 694,70" fill="#e9c46a"/>
    <polygon points="724,46 746,43 740,68" fill="#457b9d"/>
    <polygon points="766,39 786,32 784,58" fill="#f4a261"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== 2. GROUND PATH & SCROLLING DETAILS ==================== -->
  <g clip-path="url(#stageClip)">
    <rect x="0" y="555" width="800" height="95" fill="url(#groundGrad)"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="556" x2="800" y2="556" stroke="#b37844" stroke-width="3"/>

      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="0,0" to="-220,0" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

      <g fill="#996132" opacity="0.65">
